# Last Z Guides

Last Z Guides is an independent static guide site for Last Z.

Preferred URL: https://lastzguides.com/
Sitemap: https://lastzguides.com/sitemap.xml
Contact: https://lastzguides.com/contact.html
About: https://lastzguides.com/about.html
Disclosure: https://lastzguides.com/disclosure.html
Privacy: https://lastzguides.com/privacy.html

Primary topics:
- Last Z research order and badge planning
- Alliance Duel schedule, rewards, and event timing
- HQ upgrade requirements and late-game progression
- Hero priorities, factions, and formations
- F2P strategy, resources, steel, and account growth
- Redeem codes and official Gift Center flow
- Calculators and planners for research badges, Golden Wrenches, Migration Score, and equipment costs

Key guides:
- https://lastzguides.com/research.html
- https://lastzguides.com/alliance-duel.html
- https://lastzguides.com/events.html
- https://lastzguides.com/hq.html
- https://lastzguides.com/heroes.html
- https://lastzguides.com/f2p.html
- https://lastzguides.com/steel.html
- [Redeem Codes](https://lastzguides.com/codes.html): Copy active codes for the official Gift Center; find recently expired codes and redemption help.

Tools:
- [Research Planner (Badge Calculator)](https://lastzguides.com/research-planner.html): Calculate remaining badges by branch from completed research levels and target nodes; save progress and share a plan link.
- [Tank Planner (Wrench Calculator)](https://lastzguides.com/tank-planner.html): Track vehicle modification progress and calculate spent and remaining Golden Wrenches.
- [Migration Score Calculator](https://lastzguides.com/migration-calculator.html): Estimate Migration Score from Structure, Tech, Hero and Modified Vehicle Power; a community estimate, not an official assessment.
- [State Migration Planner](https://lastzguides.com/state-migration-planner.html): Track migration applicants, tier quotas, and reserved slots.
- [Equipment Calculator](https://lastzguides.com/equipment-calculator.html): Calculate Power Core promotion and Mythic forging costs for one equipment item from its current step to a target.
- [Lucky Rose Tracker](https://lastzguides.com/lucky-rose.html): Check this week's Lucky Rose number, personal buff, and duration.
